The Wizard outfit is now available to all Premium accounts; this quest gives you both addons. For the first (Skull Mask / Snake Tiara) you sacrifice four valuable items to {npc:Lugri}, a follower of Zathroth hidden near Thais. For the second (Skull Shoulder Pad / Wings) you bring 50 {item:Holy Orchid|Holy Orchids} to {npc:The Queen Of The Banshees}.
Feeling evil today? This outfit is ideal for mages who follow the dark side of sorcery. Rejected by Edron's magic academy, you may find sorcerers hiding near Thais.
**Premium** account (the base outfit is given to all Premium players).
No minimum level (100+ recommended to obtain the items).
For the 2nd addon: have the 1st addon and a {item:Family Brooch} to reach the Queen Of The Banshees.
to enter the Queen Of The Banshees area
for the hidden hole in the catacombs of the Isle of the Kings (there and back)
{wiki:Wizard Outfits|Wizard Outfit} addon Skull Mask (male) / Snake Tiara (female)
Gather all the items before talking to the NPCs to save time.
The items are sacrificed: Lugri keeps them.
1. First addon: Skull Mask / Snake Tiara
{npc:Lugri} asks you for four sacrifices to Zathroth, one at a time: {item:Medusa Shield}, {item:Dragon Scale Mail}, {item:Crown Legs} and {item:Ring of the Sky}.

{npc:Lugri} is in the cave beneath {wiki:Alatar Lake|Alatar Lake}, **north-east** of Thais (1 floor below ground level). Leave Thais, go to the lake and go down to the cave. Careful with the {creature:Bonelord|Bonelords} and {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls}. To leave, go up the same way and return to Thais, to the **south-west**.
With the {item:Medusa Shield} on you, say {key:medusa shield} and {key:yes}.
Sacrifice the Ring of the Sky
Say {key:hi}, {key:ring of the sky} and {key:yes}. Lugri gives you the first addon.
2. Second addon: Skull Shoulder Pad / Wings
You need to have the first addon and 50 {item:Holy Orchid|Holy Orchids}, which you get from {creature:Elf Arcanist|Elf Arcanists}. Gather them before talking to the queen.
Go to the Queen Of The Banshees

{npc:The Queen Of The Banshees} lives 7 floors below the sea, in a dungeon beneath the {wiki:Isle of the Kings} (you can also get there through the {wiki:Ghostlands}, but it is farther and you pass all the {creature:Banshee|Banshees}). The shortest way is via the Isle of the Kings, which you can only go to with the {item:Family Brooch}. In **Carlin**, go to {npc:Dalbrect}'s boat, in the port to the **north and west** of the city, and say {key:hi}, {key:passage}, {key:yes} (10 gp).
Dalbrect (boat to the Isle of the Kings)

On the island, enter the catacombs through the big monks' building (if {npc:Costello} won't let you through, say {key:Brother Fugio} to him). On the **6th floor** (start of the cave) head **north/north-west** and use the {item:Pick} on the hidden hole behind a structure. Go up the stairs (2 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}), head **north** and then **east** when you can. Follow the cave always **east**, then **north**, to a staircase going down. Go down: it is the queen's room, guarded by 4 {creature:Banshee|Banshees}, 3 {creature:Stalker|Stalkers}, 2 {creature:Mummy|Mummies} and 2 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts}.
Say {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. She asks you for 50 Holy Orchids.
With the 50 {item:Holy Orchid|Holy Orchids}, say {key:hi}, {key:holy orchid} and {key:yes}.

Go back the same way to the start of the cave, on the 6th floor of the catacombs: to get through the hidden hole again you have to use the {item:Pick} on it once more. Then climb the catacombs up to the monks' building and go to the boat docked on the island: say {key:hi} and {key:tibia} to {npc:Captain Jack} and he takes you back to the mainland, to the Carlin side.
Captain Jack's boat (Isle of the Kings)
